claim: Conflict determination for the Army Rules r.23(3) caution as stated in HCE-010 ('is not obliged to do so').
original_text: the accused is invited to make a statement but is not obliged to do so
rationale: Source-hierarchy determination (docs/legal-audit/SOURCE_HIERARCHY.md). (1) Gazette of 27-11-1954 (S-R23-001): authority = Central Government under AA s.191 (the notified instrument); provenance = archival reproduction of the printed Gazette (Public.Resource.Org/archive.org), identity/integrity/completeness checks passed, not custodian-certified; applicable date = 27-11-1954; prints 'You are not obliged to say anything…'. (2) India Code compilation (S-R23-002): authority = official consolidation of the same Rules (later transcription); provenance = India Code bitstream 48f52219…, annotated, no amendment marks; applicable date = unstated consolidation; prints 'You are obliged to say anything…'. (3) MML 2.pdf (S-R23-003): manual (issuer/edition not established), reproduced legal text, prints 'not obliged'; cannot override the instrument. Amendment history: per R23-VERIFY-01 amendment_chain_r23.csv (independent-reviewer-D), none of the 9 located amending instruments (1963-2022) amends r.23; the 1993 S.R.O. 17(E) runs from r.22 to r.25 without r.23. Gaps: 17 amending S.R.O.s of 1960-1991 listed in official notes, S.R.O. 258/2002, S.R.O. 2(E)/2018, anything after 06-06-2022. Weight: the notified instrument (via its archival copy) outranks the later compilation; on the instruments located, the preferred text is the 1954 Gazette wording ('not obliged') as at 06-06-2022, subject to the listed gaps. The compilation's omission of 'not' is recorded as a probable transcription discrepancy. Status remains CONFLICTING pending legal review (owner instruction); no record wording changed.
pinpoint: Gazette 27-11-1954 printed p.300; India Code compilation PDF p.41; MML 2 p.152
temporal_scope: Notified text 27-11-1954; amendment history checked on located instruments to 06-06-2022; gaps listed
advisor_questions: Does the advisor accept the archival Gazette reproduction (custody checks recorded) as evidence of the notified r.23(3) text, pending any certified copy?
Is the amendment history sufficient given the listed gaps (1960-1991 S.R.O.s, 258/2002, 2(E)/2018, post-2022)?
Should HCE-010 and related records carry a note that the India Code compilation omits 'not'?
limitations: Same model family as the reviewer.
